title: Nested skills below the start folder stop loading when the Bash sandbox is on
symptoms: Skills in subfolder .claude/skills directories are missing after upgrading to 2.1.319
Skills appear only after starting Claude Code or using /cd in that subfolder
cause: With the Bash sandbox enabled, 2.1.319 loads skills in .claude/skills folders below the starting folder only if you start there or /cd there.
fix: Start Claude Code in the folder that holds the skills, run /cd into it, or move the skills to the project root .claude/skills.
affected: Claude Code 2.1.319 and later with the Bash sandbox on
